_comment: Template for the MCP servers this skill uses. Copy the relevant entries into your agent's MCP config (Claude Code: .mcp.json at the project root, or `claude mcp add`), then fill in the redacted credentials. For sdk-docs, set X-User-Name to your Ludeo username (the local-part of your Ludeo email, e.g. jane.doe) — it identifies the caller. All three servers are optional — the skill falls back to the bundled references/ludeo-integration-docs/ when they are absent (see SKILL.md → MCP configuration). Ask the Ludeo integrations team for current URLs and credentials.

sdk-docs._purpose: Search the Ludeo SDK documentation — API reference, method signatures, parameter structs, callback chains (Unity/C# included). Primary source for SDK details at any phase. Fallback: bundled references/ludeo-integration-docs/.

ludeo-context._purpose: Ludeo company knowledge base — integration templates, QA workflows, event lists, repo context. Most useful for phase 2 (mapping) and phases 5-6 (tracking/restore and action discovery). Fallback: proceed without; analysis quality may be reduced.

ludeo-mcp._purpose: Automates Studio Lab platform work the agent otherwise hands to the user (environments, beta version, ...). Touchpoints, cadence, and the read/write policy: references/ludeo-studio-mcp.md. Fallback: ask the user to do the step in Studio Lab.
ludeo-mcp._url_note: URL, credentials, and the final server name are not settled — ask the Ludeo integrations team. A staging deployment appears as ludeo-mcp-staging; identify the server by its tools (list_game_environments, ping).
